<translate>
<!--T:5-->
The '''Giant Fish''' is a huge predatory fish found in the seas of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]] and the rivers of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]]. It hunts anyone who swims in its waters.
</translate>

<translate>
== Spawning == <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
Giant Fish spawn in oceans, deep oceans and beaches on Earth, and in the Namekian Rivers biome on Namek (spawn weight 10, groups of 1–2). They always spawn at least 2 blocks below sea level, in open water.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
The Giant Fish hunts swimmers: it speeds up and lunges to bite players and villagers in the water. It comes in several color variants, including a rare (3%) special one.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
* 1 '''Raw Giant Fish''' (cooks if on fire, +0–1 Looting)
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
The very first quest of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]], '''A Fishy Welcome''', asks you to defeat a Giant Fish in a river, beach or ocean on Earth. It rewards 2 Cooked Giant Fish.
</translate>
